normative_extracts.spec_section: W3C Web Locks API: Lock Requests
normative_extracts.quote: A lock is held until the callback's returned promise settles, or until the client's execution context terminates.
The BroadcastChannel interface represents a named channel that any browsing context of a given origin can subscribe to for message passing.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Uses the browser's C++ Lock Manager to grant an exclusive lease to one tab per origin, automatically releasing on tab close and promoting the next queued follower.

production_failures.symptom: Users are logged out across all tabs when waking a laptop with 6 open tabs
production_failures.root_cause: All 6 tabs detected an expired JWT on focus and fired parallel OAuth refresh requests; the first succeeded and rotated the token, while the second triggered token-reuse revocation.
production_failures.mitigation: Wrap token refresh in navigator.locks.request('auth-refresh', ...) and re-read the fresh token from storage once the lock is acquired.

production_failures.symptom: Follower tabs stay disconnected after user navigates the leader tab away
production_failures.root_cause: Leader tab stayed alive in bfcache while still holding the exclusive Web Lock, preventing the browser from waking the next tab.
production_failures.mitigation: Release the leader lock and close the WebSocket inside the pagehide event handler.
